afrexai-ux-research-engine-bak 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release of a complete UX Research & Design system skill.
- Provides structured UX research planning, including brief templates and methodology selection matrix.
- Features sample size calculators for qualitative, quantitative, and A/B testing.
- Includes ready-to-use screener and interview guide templates.
- Covers participant recruiting best practices and a quality checklist.
- Designed for zero dependencies and pure agent operation.
